svg.title: Sampler::Pick step by step
svg.text: Sampler::Pick for the token after "Tonight? Tonight" (Mei's reply), unit_draw = 0.597
history = context_, 117 tokens. temperature 0.7, top_k 20, top_p 0.8, repetition_penalty 1.1.
draw = unit_draw × kept_mass = 0.597 × 0.803 = 0.480; the kept candidates end to end, each as wide as its probability:
Coral square: the token is in history, so its logit is divided by 1.1 (a negative one would be multiplied). "," had the highest logit;
after the penalty "␣is" is first. Penalized out of the top 20: "␣you".
1: each token in history once, over all 151,665 logits
2–5: temperature, the 20 highest sorted, softmax over them, the nucleus
6: subtract each kept probability from the draw until it goes below zero
